semiconductor_relevance: High — Resonac Corporation is a significant player in the semiconductor materials sector, providing a wide range of products essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Resonac Corporation, formed through the integration of Showa Denko and Showa Denko Materials, specializes in developing advanced materials for semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include ceria slurry for CMP, copper-clad laminates for package substrates, and die bonding films, catering to various stages of the semiconductor production process.
capabilities: Ceria slurry for chemical mechanical polishing (CMP)
Dry film resist for copper wiring formation
Die bonding films for chip mounting
